program_name: Bachelor of Science in Pharmaceutical Technology (Hons)

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM138,635. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0056519/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: STPM / Matriculation / A-Level / Pre-University / Foundation C (2.50 CGPA) in Biology/Physics and Chemistry SPM or equivalent CREDIT or equivalent in five (5) subjects including three (3) from Biology, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, English Diploma (MQF Level 4) in a related field 2.50 CGPA; CGPA below 2.50 may be supported by at least two (2) years (24 months) working experience in a relevant field South Australia Matriculation (SAM) At least 65-70% of the aggregate or TER / UAI 75 Canadian Pre-University (CPU) At least 80% aggregate Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) Grade B in five (5) subjects Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.
